See in Darkness (Su)
Source Bestiary 6 pg. 298, Bestiary 2 pg. 301, Bestiary 3 pg. 299, Bestiary 4 pg. 299, Bestiary 5 pg. 299
The creature can see perfectly in darkness of any kind, including that created by deeper darkness.
